description: Take payments with payment links and hosted pages, manage payments, customers and disputes.

checkout_com_dispute_lost_trigger.description: Runs when you lose a dispute.

output.dispute: The record returned by the service

checkout_com_dispute_status_changed_trig.description: Runs when a dispute moves to a new status, such as evidence under review, won or lost.

output.dispute: The record returned by the service

checkout_com_dispute_won_trigger.description: Runs when you win a dispute.

output.dispute: The record returned by the service

checkout_com_new_dispute_trigger.description: Runs when a customer disputes a payment (a chargeback).

output.dispute: The record returned by the service

checkout_com_new_payment_trigger.description: Runs when a customer makes a new payment, whether it is approved, pending or declined.

output.payment: The record returned by the service

checkout_com_payment_captured_trigger.description: Runs when the money for a payment is collected, in full or in part.

output.payment: The record returned by the service

checkout_com_payment_declined_trigger.description: Runs when a payment is declined.

output.payment: The record returned by the service

checkout_com_payment_refunded_trigger.description: Runs when a payment from the last 7 days is refunded, in full or in part.

output.payment: The record returned by the service

checkout_com_payment_status_changed_trig.description: Runs when a payment from the last 7 days moves to a new status, such as captured, refunded or voided.

output.payment: The record returned by the service
